key.name: panel-height
key.description: Height of the bottom panel in logical pixels (scaled for HiDPI).

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of application icons in the taskbar, in logical pixels.

key.name: tray-icon-size
key.description: Size of system tray / right-side icons (Quick Settings, keyboard flag, etc.), in logical pixels.

key.name: panel-item-order
key.description: Order of right-side panel items. Known ids: clock, system, keyboard.

key.name: panel-spacing
key.description: Horizontal spacing between panel sections and icons, in logical pixels.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Edge of the screen where the panel is placed. Only "bottom" is supported.

key.name: panel-margin
key.description: Margin between the panel and the screen edges, in logical pixels. Creates a floating dock look when greater than zero.

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the panel background, in logical pixels.

key.name: panel-opacity
key.description: Background opacity of the panel (0.0–1.0).

key.name: use-custom-panel-color
key.description: When enabled, use panel-color instead of the light/dark theme default background.

key.name: panel-color
key.description: Custom panel/dock background color as #RRGGBB. Opacity is controlled separately by panel-opacity.

key.name: enable-blur
key.description: Apply a blur effect behind the panel when the compositor supports it.

key.name: show-favorites
key.description: Show favorite applications in the taskbar.

key.name: show-running-apps
key.description: Show running application icons in the taskbar.

key.name: show-show-apps-button
key.description: Show the grid button that opens the application overview.

key.name: show-workspaces
key.description: Show a workspace indicator on the panel.

key.name: show-clock
key.description: Show the GNOME date/clock menu (calendar and notifications) on the panel.

key.name: clock-position
key.description: Where to place the clock on the panel: "center" or "right".

key.name: clock-style
key.description: Clock face style: "default" (native GNOME clock) or "seven-segment".

key.name: clock-format
key.description: Show hours and minutes ("hm") or hours, minutes, and seconds ("hms").

key.name: clock-colon-blink
key.description: Blink the colon separator on the seven-segment clock.

key.name: clock-led-color
key.description: LED color for the seven-segment clock: "red", "green", "blue", or "amber".

key.name: clock-hour-format
key.description: 12-hour or 24-hour display for the seven-segment clock.

key.name: show-system-indicators
key.description: Move Quick Settings and related system indicators into the bottom panel.

key.name: multi-monitor
key.description: Create a bottom panel on every monitor. System indicators stay on the primary monitor.

key.name: isolate-monitors
key.description: Show only windows belonging to each monitor in that monitor's taskbar.

key.name: isolate-workspaces
key.description: Show only windows belonging to the current workspace in the taskbar.

key.name: hide-overview-dash
key.description: Hide the default dash inside the Activities overview.

key.name: animate-startup
key.description: Slide the panel in when the extension is enabled.

key.name: scroll-panel-workspaces
key.description: Switch workspaces by scrolling on empty panel areas.

key.name: show-keyboard-layout
key.description: Show a keyboard layout indicator on the panel.

key.name: keyboard-display-mode
key.description: How to show the layout: "character" (e.g. fa), "flag" (rectangular country flag), or "both".
